dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Helmets on, sit tight, and don't fall!

dialogues.speaker: Xbalanque
dialogues.text: Is this a board you can use to ride on the water? And you can stick it to the back of vehicles, too! Genius!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is Mavuika's flamestrider! Oh, we call that board a "surfboard"!

dialogues.speaker: Xbalanque
dialogues.text: Haha, you learn something new all the time!
